notes.title: Dungeon Rampage Demo & Kickstarter Aftermath!
notes.content:
THANK YOU, RAMPAGERS!!!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45060016/96ab253c02fe943b40378f46e7dd1a418a7a385e.png"]



We’re thrilled to announce we’ve officially smashed through our Kickstarter funding goal!! With $70,463 raised by over 1,600 mighty backers, you’ve made it loud and clear that you’re ready to pledge your warrior’s honor for a revived and restored Dungeon Rampage.

But that’s not all! Alongside our Kickstarter success, you also flooded our Steam demo and proved to us in numbers how much you love this game. At almost 100k players, with over 1000 reviews and a 97% Overwhelmingly Positive rating, you did more than bring this game back from the dead… You chucked evil lord Dingplepus down into the moat, sank him with a boulder and propped Dungeon Rampage on his gilded throne for all to see.

This was just a quick numbers recap to show you how far we’ve come and what you were able to accomplish. From now on, you might not hear from us for a while as we refocus on finishing up the game. But fear not! We’ll check in with real updates when we have progress worth sharing.


Thanks again for your patience and see you soonish,

– The Dungeon Rampage Team

PS: We have updated our Steam art & description, hope you like the new look!
